selected_binding.source: Dawnwood_Interactive_Formalization.pdf physical p6, equation (7), explicitly proposed [P]: H diag(1,exp(i*phase)) H. Unified v0.2 p5 keeps the hinge numerical binding open.
selected_binding.meaning: ComplexPair and explicit phase -> ComplexPair. The same-epoch expression contains exactly two H applications. Input phase is supplied; carrier/pinion phase construction and circulation are not lowered in this component.
selected_binding.status: Explicit chosen source-body overload; FP32 evaluation of analytic formula, not the complete source application.

executed_by_this_component: explicit numerical preconditions, then selected scalar-expression outputs over supplied input rows
not_lowered: whole application cycle and its schedule
lowering.cycle_input: No cycle file is consumed by this body-only compiler.
lowering.metadata: Binding source, meaning and status are retained provenance; they are not instructions.

precondition_policy: Each requires expression emits opcode17 before output expressions; zero fails the lane and any finite nonzero value satisfies the guard.
numeric_input_policy: Finite constants and inputs rounded to IEEE FP32 before execution; negative zero bits retained.
optimization: Identical instruction tuples are shared; no algebraic rewriting or constant folding.

source_input_fp32_rounding.reference: JSON numbers decoded as Python numeric values before packing; compiled_input_rows_fp32 are the actual execution inputs.
